meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 Dieter Rams 十项「好设计」原则逐条给设计打 0–3 分并附证据,判出新建/精修/重做三种结论,最后产出可直接运行的 /make-plan 提示词。
howto.when: 当你提到 “audit this design”“design review” 等词,或想要一份能引出计划的批评时触发;它不做常规 UI 代码审查。

say.text: 审查这个设计,按 Rams 十项原则逐条打分
say.note: 会生成评分卡与结论文件

say.text: 看看这个界面够不够好,该精修还是重做
给我一份对应的 /make-plan 提示词
say.note: 输出可复制的计划提示词

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude audits a design against Dieter Rams' ten principles, scoring each 0–3 with cited evidence, then returns a NEW / REFINE / REDESIGN verdict plus a ready-to-run /make-plan prompt.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "audit this design" or "design review", or ask for a critique that should lead to a plan. Not for routine UI code reviews.

say_en.text: Audit this design against Rams' ten principles
Is this UI good — refine it or redesign it?
